findings.title: Inconsistent casing for zone identifier
findings.body: The new field `shipping_zone` uses UPPER_CASE while the rest of the module uses snake_case for identifiers (e.g., `order_id`, `destination`). According to custom instructions in 'Naming Consistency' (casing must follow existing module style): snake_case should be used for identifiers in this module.

findings.title: Potential KeyError if shipping_address.zone is None
findings.body: The code assumes `order.shipping_address.zone` exists and is not None. If the zone is missing, this will raise a `KeyError` or `AttributeError` at runtime. The surrounding context does not show defensive handling for this case.

summary.problem: The change introduces an inconsistent casing style and a potential runtime error due to unhandled None values.
summary.done_well: The new field `shipping_zone` is added to the response, extending the existing structure cleanly.
